name: extension_stack6_sizes
description: EXTENSION (not part of the pilot): same board and JJ-AA 24-hand ranges, pot 3 (1 bb prior each), equal stacks 6 bb, opening sizes half-pot, pot and all-in, one raise allowed (to pot or all-in; full raises only; no short all-in raise), no open fold. An action abstraction: omitted sizes can create artificial deterrence.
